gift.subject: We built supplements into an RPG
gift.body:
Hi {{first_name:"there"}},

I came across {{company:"your site"}} while looking for outlets that cover gaming and geek gifts, and I think what we're making is right up your alley.

Ten years ago my business partner Vito and I were packing orders in my dad's supplement warehouse, talking about a gummy company for gamers. We kept working together through three companies and kept coming back to the idea. Code Name is soft launched now, with our big launch on January 1. We sell four supplement gummies through a pixel-art world called the Realm, where four characters each keep a product and talk to you in their voice. It's built for people who want to start on their health and need an easy first step, and we made that step feel like the opening scene of a game.

I'd love to send you a jar to try, no strings attached. And if it ever makes one of your gift guides, we're open to setting you up with an affiliate link so it pays you back too.

Bennett Eibel
Founder, Code Name
codenamehealth.com
1509 W Cypress St, Tampa, FL 33606
